# Copilot Instructions

When making a git commit, always follow `.github/skills/git-commit-message.md`.

When creating a pull request, always follow `.github/skills/pull-request-summary.md`.

When asked to write unit tests for any language (including .NET, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Go, or any language following Arrange-Act-Assert patterns), always follow `.github/skills/unit-testing.md`.
